name: Document Section Change Entry
description: Single section change entry used by sectionChanges.add/modify. The section's relatedContracts should align with the keys provided in contracts.

sectionKey.description: Contracts key under /contracts for the Document Section marker.

section.description: Document Section contract node; must include type Conversation/Document Section and relatedContracts should list keys in contracts.

contracts.description: Map of contractKey -> contract node to add or replace for this section.
